81: std::string render_template(
82:     std::string_view text,
83:     const std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>, 6>&
84:         replacements) {
85:     std::string rendered;
86:     rendered.reserve(text.size());
87: 
88:     size_t pos = 0;
89:     while (pos < text.size()) {
90:         size_t start = text.find("{{", pos);
91:         if (start == std::string_view::npos) {
92:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));
93:             break;
94:         }
95: 
96:         size_t end = text.find("}}", start + 2);
97:         if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
98:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));
99:             break;
100:         }
101: 
102:         rendered.append(text.substr(pos, start - pos));
103:         std::string_view placeholder = text.substr(start, end + 2 - start);
104:         bool replaced = false;
105:         for (const auto& [from, to] : replacements) {
106:             if (placeholder == from) {
107:                 rendered.append(to);
108:                 replaced = true;
109:                 break;
110:             }
111:         }
112: 
113:         if (!replaced) {
114:             rendered.append(placeholder);
115:         }
116:         pos = end + 2;
117:     }
118: 
119:     return rendered;
120: }

226: void Logger::run() {
227:     while (true) {
228:         std::queue<LogEntry> local_queue;
229: 
230:         {
231:             std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
232:             this->condition.wait(
233:                 lock, [this] { return this->stop || !this->queue.empty(); });
234: 
235:             if (this->stop && this->queue.empty()) {
236:                 return;
237:             }
238: 
239:             local_queue.swap(this->queue);
240:         }
241: 
242:         while (!local_queue.empty()) {
243:             const auto& entry = local_queue.front();
244:             auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
245:             std::string date = Logger::date_string(now);
246:             this->rotate_if_needed(date);
247: 
248:             if (this->output.is_open()) {
249:                 this->output << Logger::timestamp_string(now) << " ["
250:                              << Logger::level_name(entry.level)
251:                              << "]: " << entry.message << '\n';
252:                 ++this->current_line_count;
253:             }
254:             local_queue.pop();
255:         }
256: 
257:         this->output.flush();
258:     }
259: }

261: void Logger::rotate_if_needed(const std::string& date) {
262:     if (this->current_date != date) {
263:         if (this->output.is_open()) {
264:             this->output.close();
265:         }
266: 
267:         this->current_date = date;
268:         this->current_file_index = 0;
269:         this->current_line_count = 0;
270:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
271:         return;
272:     }
273: 
274:     if (!this->output.is_open()) {
275:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
276:         return;
277:     }
278: 
279:     if (this->current_line_count >= this->max_lines_per_file) {
280:         this->output.close();
281:         ++this->current_file_index;
282:         this->current_line_count = 0;
283:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
284:     }
